messages:
Amelia: Morning team — kicking off onboarding for Solstice Health. Need to align stakeholders, success criteria, and a 30/60/90 timeline. Main contacts on their side: Solstice PM @Luca, Eng lead @Raj, Security lead Marta. Tentative kickoff Thu 10:00 PT. Any initial concerns?

Luca: Thanks Amelia. Quick priorities from our side: 1) API integration E2E, 2) SSO + data handling, 3) perf targets (p95 < 300ms). We can prepare sample prompts and an eval set by next Wed.

Raj: We can stand up the integration sandbox tomorrow. Need confirmation on model pinning policy (which model family to pin for the pilot). Also will require network whitelist details for Private deployment.

Marta: Security notes: will need SOC2 scope confirmation and IP allowlist for the initial pilot. Also KMS/HSM integration details from infra. Can we add a compliance checkpoint at day 14?

Zoe: Drafting proposed success criteria: a) 3 core flows validated (ingest, generate, rerank), b) latency & cost within agreed budget, c) 10 product staff trained and able to run evals. Add an adoption metric (DAU for the feature) as a renewal leading indicator?

Amelia: Yes — good call on the adoption metric. I'll create a shared success-criteria doc and link it here. Enablement plan: two 1-hr training sessions (week 2 & week 4) plus an office hours slot every Friday during the pilot.

Raj: Flagging a potential renewal risk: Solstice expects meaningful results within 60 days. We should prioritize quick wins to show ROI within 30 days.

Luca: Agreed. Proposed rollout: Sandbox (week1), E2E test + security signoff (week2), Pilot (week3-4), Prod rollout (week5). Can we confirm API keys and quota by Monday?

OnboardBot: Calendar invite created: "Solstice Onboard - Kickoff" Thu 10:00 PT. Attendees: Amelia, Luca, Raj, Marta, Zoe. Meet link: https://meet.redwood.com/solstice-kickoff

Amelia: Action items captured: Amelia -> success doc & shared drive link (EOD today). Raj -> sandbox access + whitelist (by Mon). Luca -> sample prompts & eval set (by Wed). Marta -> compliance checklist & KMS notes (by Tue). Zoe -> training calendar + invite templates (by Fri). Please ack if you own an item.

Luca: I'll upload the prompt set and tag the eval owner in the doc.

Raj: Sandbox creds request sent to infra. Sending CIDR ranges for whitelist in a DM now.

Marta: Uploading SOC2 scope snippet and the initial KMS onboarding checklist to the shared folder.

Zoe: Drafting a 30-day cadence email to Solstice CSM now — will include renewal guardrails and suggested success signals.

Amelia: Any blockers? If not, closing thread for now and will paste the success-criteria link once done. See you at kickoff. :tada:

Luca: :thumbsup:

Raj: No blockers from eng.

Marta: No blockers; will escalate if anything changes.

Amelia: Great — capturing everything into the playbook. /cc @product to sync on any feature flags that need enabling for the pilot.
